name: IdleCord
author: hatch
description: An idle hero-collector RPG played inside Discord. Collect heroes from four factions, build a five-hero formation with ultimate rules, push the campaign and ascend your roster while idle loot piles up.
install_msg: Thanks for installing IdleCord! Players start with `[p]idlecord start`. Admins can pick a brag channel with `[p]idlecord setup #channel`.
short: Idle hero-collector RPG built on Components V2
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs along with IdleCord game progress (heroes, resources, teams and settings), and a public post channel ID per server. Data can be deleted on request.
